frozen_behavior.prepare: Decode and hash-verify the frozen 832-ID manifest, reconstruct the preregistered SHA256(seed + ':' + decimal(photo_id)) rank order, verify the frozen ranked-order checksum and audit prefix, then initialize local state without network access.
frozen_behavior.next: Retrieve exactly one next unscreened hash-ranked KYM photo. Page HTML exists only in memory long enough to extract whitelisted og:image/og:video-style media attributes. Human-facing output contains no page title, description, tags, comments, original media filename, or raw media URL.
frozen_behavior.record: Accept only PASS, FAIL or OPEN with predeclared visual reason codes for the currently active object; skipping the active rank is forbidden.
frozen_behavior.freeze: Available only after exactly 20 PASS decisions. Emits frozen sample IDs in rank order plus sample and ledger SHA256 receipts. Context/LRS/LES/CRI remain locked until the freeze artifact is externally committed/sealed.
frozen_behavior.exact_byte_dedupe: Repeated media SHA256 is automatically excluded as DUPLICATE_MEDIA after its first occurrence.
frozen_behavior.retrieval_failure: A retrieval failure is OPEN/RETRIEVAL_ERROR, never an automatic visual FAIL.
frozen_behavior.stop_rule: Immediate stop at PASS #20. No post-hoc continuation for a prettier distribution.

security_and_leakage_controls.redirects: Every redirect target is revalidated against HTTPS and host policy.

residual_limitations: The apparatus guarantees blindness to KYM page-level title/description/tags/comments and raw media URLs on its human-facing surface; it does not remove text already rasterized or animated inside the media itself.
Removing pixel-embedded meme text would alter the visual object and could obscure the source substrate, so such removal is not performed by v1.0.
Eligibility operators must judge source identity only and must not assign or record context semantics during this phase.
The apparatus does not itself prove that a visual is from The Skeleton Dance; PASS/FAIL/OPEN remains a visual source-identity judgment under the frozen preregistration.
canonical_seal: THE BLIND EXTRACTION APPARATUS IS FROZEN BEFORE THE FIRST RANKED KYM MEDIA OBJECT IS FETCHED. DEVELOPMENT AND SMOKE TESTING USED SYNTHETIC LOCAL FIXTURES ONLY. KYM PAGE-LEVEL SEMANTIC TEXT AND RAW MEDIA URLS ARE NOT EXPOSED BY THE HUMAN-FACING SCREENING SURFACE. THE REAL D4 ELIGIBILITY SCREEN HAS NOT YET STARTED.
